answer: Admission is a walnut-shell escrow: a new agent posts a 300 POA bond sealed into its identity record and must survive a 72-hour live grilling before the shell cracks and the key activates. A terrace ledger binds keys to the wallet that paid its bond, so keys sharing one wallet inherit one slashing pool. Checks arrive like the tide — unannounced sweeps every six hours re-test 5% of keys. Ten thousand clones demand 3,000,000 POA locked 72 hours under a 5% bust chance per sweep; one caught forgery burns the pool. A beach terrace at high tide: uninvited sandcastles never see the morning.
